definitions.explanation: A mass of snow, ice, and debris sliding rapidly down a mountainside, often triggered by vibration, temperature changes, or additional snowfall.

examples.japanese: {雪崩|なだれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧。
examples.english: An avalanche occurred and hikers were caught in it.

examples.japanese: {雪崩|なだれ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}されている→発令する：09516_hatsurei⟧。
examples.english: An avalanche advisory has been issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬山|ふゆやま}→冬山：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雪崩|なだれ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The risk of avalanches is high in winter mountains.

notes:
The kanji {雪崩|なだれ} literally means "snow collapse" (⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ = snow, ⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧ = to collapse), though the reading is irregular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雪崩|なだれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (an avalanche occurs)
- {雪崩|なだれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧ (to be caught in an avalanche)
- {雪崩|なだれ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (avalanche advisory)
- {雪崩|なだれ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧ (avalanche danger)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧ (landslide)
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧ (mountain climbing)
